note: How each operator's own stated KYC policy behaves, assigned by hand. A rule-based pass over the policy wording was tried first and filed Gamdom, Gamba, Dustbit and Degencity as 'required' when all four say plainly that KYC is not required — the pattern for 'required' matched before the pattern for 'no KYC'. Labelling an operator's compliance policy wrongly is not a near-miss, so every row here was read. The policy text and its source URL stay in casinoSpecSheets.json; this only says which shape it is.

tiers.never: States outright that it will not ask, at any amount.
tiers.discretionary: No routine check. Documents may be requested — for a withdrawal, on suspicion, or at the operator's discretion — and most reserve that right explicitly.
tiers.threshold: Verification at a trigger the operator publishes: a cumulative amount, a single withdrawal size, or a deadline after the first deposit.
tiers.required: Verification is a step you complete to play or to withdraw, not a contingency.
tiers.conflicting: The operator's own sources disagree with each other. Recorded as its own answer rather than resolved by picking the friendlier one.

toshibet.why: Help centre says it will never KYC you, whatever the amount — the only unconditional claim of the 46.

fortunejack.why: Total deposits reaching $10,000, or suspicious activity.

winna.why: Within 30 days of first deposit, before first withdrawal, or at EUR 2,000 wagered.

bc-game.why: Basic KYC is a photo ID plus a five-angle selfie; advanced KYC adds proof of address.

shuffle.why: A threshold exists but is not published, and an ID check comes before the first withdrawal regardless.

rollbit.why: Up to five verification levels with ID and camera check.

7bit.why: Withdrawals unlock only after ID, address and payment proof.

goated.why: Level 1 — name, date of birth, address — needed to bet and withdraw.

yeet.why: Level 1 KYC required to deposit, before any play.

razed.why: Calls itself a No-KYC casino, but its own AML policy requests ID documents at withdrawal. The label is marketing; the policy is the policy.

jackpotbet.why: ID, proof of address and a selfie holding the ID, on any deposit and on withdrawal.

spartans.why: ID verification before the first withdrawal.

coincasino.why: Level 1 account details before fiat deposits; ID, proof of address, selfie or call before betting or withdrawing.

wager-com.why: Its AML policy puts ID and proof of address at registration; other pages do not. Recorded as conflicting rather than resolved.

1win.why: Its crypto guide says no mandatory KYC on withdrawals; its terms are stricter. Both are its own pages.

roobet.why: Documents may be requested at any time; withdrawals refused until verified.

stake.why: Compliance team may request any documentation at any time.

gamdom.why: Not required to deposit, play or withdraw unless specifically requested.

duelbits.why: May request documents; access restricted until complete.

rainbet.why: Crypto play and withdrawals need no KYC; requested on suspicious activity.

500-casino.why: May request any documentation, to be provided within 7 days.

vave.why: Generally no documents; ID or selfie if issues arise.

betplay.why: No verification requirement in its terms; it collects email and usage data only.

thrill.why: No KYC to register; verification may come later.

duel.why: Reserves the right to request KYC before a withdrawal, and disclaims liability for funds locked meanwhile.

betfury.why: May request documentation at any time.

gamba.why: No KYC required to play; four verification levels are optional.

solcasino.why: Checks run through Sumsub; a selfie with ID may be required.

whale-io.why: May require KYC for any withdrawal or reward redemption.

acebet.why: May require KYC/AML documents at its discretion.

degen.why: Registration collects name, date of birth and address, but documents are reserved rather than routine.

qzino.why: May require photo ID and proof of address.

shock.why: Account details required to transact; ID checks at its discretion.

cybet.why: Risk-based; full KYC only when needed for security or compliance.

housebets.why: Not a standard step; most players are never asked.

dicey.why: May require verification and photo ID, including before withdrawals.

flush.why: Not required for standard play; requested in specific cases.

degencity.why: Deposit, play and withdraw without KYC; a verified email address is needed to withdraw.

dustbit.why: No KYC to play or withdraw; may request ID or source of funds.

bluff.why: Usually not needed to withdraw — but required if you opt into a bonus.
